scientific_integrity: Main inequalities established analytically; finite numerical tests are supplemental. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Full-height parallel roads in a rectangular reserve; uniform seed sources; independent isotropic single-step dispersal. First-order optimality only in joint shrinking-road/fixed-distance limit. Not field calibrated. Priority provisional, no independent validation.
title: A width-aware seed-loss bound for habitats separated by narrow roadways
